name: GeoTIFF
notes: Orthophotos, elevation models (DSM, DTM), multispectral and thermal mosaics. A TIFF without a coordinate system is an Image.

name: JPEG 2000
notes: The georeference comes from the GeoJP2 or GMLJP2 box. A nodata value is not read; an alpha channel is kept. Without a coordinate system it is an Image.

name: LAS / LAZ
notes: LiDAR and photogrammetry point clouds.

name: E57
notes: Terrestrial laser scans.

name: PTS / XYZ
notes: Text point lists.

name: PLY point cloud
notes: A PLY with points and no faces. DroneDB reads the header of every PLY to decide if it is a point cloud, a mesh or a Gaussian splat.

name: Wavefront OBJ
notes: Upload the .mtl file and the textures with the model. A build that misses one of them waits until the file is uploaded.

name: glTF / GLB
notes: A glTF with meshes. A glTF without a mesh (only points or lines) is a Generic file.

name: PLY mesh
notes: A PLY with faces, with or without one texture. A PLY with several textures is a Generic file.

name: STL
notes: ASCII and binary. Before DroneDB 2.0 an STL was a Generic file: rescan the dataset to change existing ones.

name: OGC 3D Tiles archive
notes: A ZIP with tileset.json at its root. A georeferenced tileset is placed on the globe.

name: Gaussian splat PLY
notes: The 3DGS layout or the SuperSplat compressed layout, binary little-endian.

name: SPLAT
notes: 32 bytes per splat, no spherical harmonics.

name: SPZ
notes: SPZ versions 1 to 4.

name: KSPLAT
notes: Cannot be converted to .spz for other tools.

name: SOG
notes: A single-file ZIP bundle. The number of splats is unknown until the build. Cannot be converted to .spz.

name: RAD
builds: Checked and published as it is
notes: The level-of-detail format that a build writes. The number of splats is unknown. Cannot be converted to .spz.

name: Shapefile
notes: Upload the .shx and .dbf files (and the .prj, .cpg) with the .shp; a build that misses one waits for it. A .shz is a zipped shapefile.

name: GeoPackage
notes: Every layer with at least one feature is kept.

name: KML / KMZ
notes: A KMZ can hold several layers.

name: GPX
notes: Tracks, routes and waypoints. Empty layers are left out.

name: DXF (CAD drawing)
view: Map, or the 3D viewer without a coordinate system
notes: The coordinate system comes from a .prj next to it, from the drawing, or (DXF only) from coordinates that fit longitude and latitude. Set one in Hub with Set Coordinate System.

name: DWG (CAD drawing)
view: Map, or the 3D viewer without a coordinate system
notes: DWG R13 to R2018, converted to DXF with LibreDWG. 3D solids are not converted. Coordinate system as for DXF, except the longitude and latitude rule.

name: Photo
notes: GeoImage when the EXIF/XMP metadata has a GPS position, else Image. Thermal R-JPEGs and the bands of multispectral cameras are photos too. A TIFF or JPEG 2000 with a coordinate system is a GeoRaster.

name: Panorama (360°)
notes: An image at least twice as wide as it is high. GeoPanorama when it has a GPS position.

name: Video
notes: GeoVideo when the metadata has a GPS position, else Video.

name: Markdown
notes: A README.md describes the dataset. Users who can write edit it in Hub.

name: PDF
notes: For example the processing report of OpenDroneMap.

name: Text
notes: Files up to 5 MB open in the text editor of Hub. Other source and configuration formats open there too.

name: Archive
notes: Hub extracts it into the dataset. The ddb command line indexes it as one file and does not extract it.

name: DroneDB dataset
notes: A folder that holds its own .ddb index.

name: Any other file
notes: Stored, listed and downloadable. Companion files (.mtl, textures, .shx, .dbf, georeference sidecars, _cameras.json) are Generic files too.
